universe: markets present in data/pm_rewards_shadow.jsonl during the evaluation window

include_if_all.vol_definition: stdev of 5-minute changes in YES mid, in cents, computed ONLY from shadow rows before frozen_at_utc (markets added later: first 60 minutes of their own rows, which are then excluded from evaluation)
include_if_all.days_to_resolution_definition: market end date (end_date_iso) minus frozen_at_utc; markets with no end date are excluded

fill_models.A_book_cross: fill when next snapshot best ask <= our prior bid (or best bid >= our prior ask), as recorded by the shadow
fill_models.B_trade_print: fill whenever a public trade prints at or through our resting level in the minute after we quote (YES-equivalent price; full quote size filled), in addition to A; inventory marked to mid

notes: Frozen before looking at further data. Keyword list is deliberately broad (excludes tariff/election/senate/president/announce markets too). Rewards estimate assumes quotes at best bid/ask with full queue credit.
